The 2025 annual figures average the 11 months BLS published (January to September, November and December). BLS says the 2025 figures are not strictly comparable with other years.

changes.title: Union membership by state first published
changes.summary: BLS union members and workers represented by unions in every state and DC, 2024 and 2025: in 2025, 10.0% of U.S. wage and salary workers were union members, from 2.3% in South Dakota to 24.8% in Hawaii.
